capabilities: view a home dashboard with focus, idea inbox, and recent notes
filter, create, edit, complete, and delete task notes
run independent per-task timers stored in frontmatter
reschedule unfinished tasks by dragging them on a calendar or timeline
map frontmatter field names and folders in a setup wizard
extras: Default task field names and folders are Chinese (e.g. 累计耗时秒, 目标与任务/任务管理/任务), but all are remappable; includes one-click initialization that creates recommended folders and a task template without overwriting files; explicitly makes no network requests or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in home dashboard that gathers existing Markdown task notes, shows their status, picks a focus task, and tracks time in one place.
summary: Local-first dashboard and task workbench that turns Markdown tasks with frontmatter into a home view with focus timers and calendar rescheduling.
